newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade very slow. Not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test.

Inquiry moderate, demand light. Sales confirmed on 500 slaughter steers and 1700 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 17800 head confirmed, including 9500 head or about 53 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1325 lbs
Slaughter Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1040-1100 lbs
70.00-73.00; select with end Choice 1000-1050 lbs 70.00; pen
mixed Commercial to Choice 1225 lb heifers and heiferettes
